producer_headlines.TASK-20260806-b51ac8: B2-A, the repaired C3 instrument. P4 (Gaussian null-of-the-null) holds in all four cells, largest deviation 0.88 SE against a 4-SE budget (report.md sec 2). P3 (coordinate-aligned vs. Haar, SE-of-the-difference declared and shown, not asserted) holds in all four cells by 46.8-73.2 SE against a 4-SE gate (report.md sec 3, sha256-verified against results.json this session). P5, the pre-registered ~1/sqrt(beta) falsifier, is direction-consistent at both d=100 and d=140 (measured decay ratios 0.8926 and 0.8903 against predicted 0.8018 and 0.8257 -- correct sign, magnitude 7.8-11.3% off the naive formula, reported as a discrepancy rather than rounded away). A construction defect (D-1, an unnormalised G matrix collapsing the interior graded-family grid) was found after run 1, proved and verified bit-for-bit to leave P1-P5 unaffected, and fixed before run 2; both runs are preserved. Per the pre-registered branch, the real arm's P1/P2 is then read as interpretable, and passes in all four cells -- but the report repeats, unprompted, that P1/P2 also pass identically on the Haar null, so this carries little independent information beyond what BATCH-a51f91 already found; the informative content is P3/P4/P5's demonstration that the instrument CAN discriminate a real effect, plus the unreduced/LLL-only arms showing the raw q-ary basis departs from Beta (2.3-5.5%) and reduction removes it.
producer_headlines.TASK-20260806-4810e2: B2-B, the C1 bound. Zero new BKZ reductions, zero new estimator calls. Lane (a) (R20 SSH, R21 IKEv2): attainable reduction <= 0 bits, exactly, model-independent (the convexity bound uses only the sign of f'' being positive, not its magnitude), so no f'' table applies to this lane. Lane (b) (the eight count-unstated modes): no bound is sourceable from mathematics or the standards stack; the task explicitly declines to substitute an illustrative M, citing K1's rejected 'manufactured bound from an absence' as the precedent it will not repeat, and reproduces the dbeta/beta formula symbolically with M left free. The f'' sensitivity table reuses T3's own RC.MATZOV OLS measurement (0.27416-0.28039 bits/block against the nominal 0.292, a 4.14-6.51% overstatement) and its beta-staircase quantisation noise (3/2/3 anomalous intervals). CM-2 addressed by naming C_query/C_storage/C_selection as explicit unquantified >=0 terms alongside the priced C_reduction.
producer_headlines.TASK-20260806-3b0337: B2-C, the normative-gap write-up. A draft, self-labelled UNPROMOTED and rule-12-gated throughout, restating CX-1's corrected four-way row split (2 firm single-use: R20/R21; 2 caveated single-use: R09/R22; 2 per-handshake reuse-permitting: R12/R14; 8 count-unstated) with every row and quotation hash-checked against BATCH-a51f91's committed census.json (sha256 confirmed identical to the blob at snapshot 7983a474), traces the standards delegation chain on both limbs, and closes with an explicit non-claims section: no vulnerability demonstrated at any count.
producer_headlines.TASK-20260806-9918cd: B2-D, the acquisition procedure and independent retrieval check. Documents an OpenAlex/Unpaywall aggregator step, refined from the red team's own procedure to iterate all locations[] entries rather than only best_oa_location (the ACM route in best_oa_location was paywalled, HTTP 403; the working copy came from locations[1], the TU/e repository). Independently reproduced HTTP status (200), content type, byte count (1,832,736, all 5 of its own fetches) and page count (17, all 5 fetches) exactly against RT-20260806-d008e0's reported values. Did NOT reproduce the red team's reported sha256 -- and found its own five fetches of the identical URL return five different sha256 values, isolated by byte-diff to PDF font-subset-tag metadata (not document content) in the TU/e repository's per-request serving, verified with three independent hashing tools. Reported as an honest non-match and a genuine hash-instability finding, not smoothed over.
